Tonight at 7:00 PM ET, authors **Eli Clifton** and **Ian Lustick** join Drop
Site for a live conversation on their new book, _Israel 's Lobby_, digging
into how campaign cash and political pressure built one of the most powerful
lobbying operations in Washington, and why crossing it can end careers. Drop
Site's **Ryan Grim** and **Murtaza Hussain** host, and you'll get your
questions answered by the group live.

Tonight's event is exclusive to paid subscribers, the people who make our work
possible. Haven't upgraded yet? You can still join us tonight, just hit
